name: vision
headline: The *vision*
visualData: Superimposable trees — your view and mine of one place, stacked and reconciled
Interests, not feeds — only what meets your private interests reaches you
One decoration model — a filter is a bouquet of marks, not a hardcoded type
say: Further out. Superimposable trees: your view and my view of the same place, stacked, and reconciled like layers. Interests instead of feeds: people leave interests on what they read, and only what matches your own private interests reaches you. And one decoration model, where a filter is a bouquet of marks instead of a hardcoded type.
